summary: The dashboard demonstrates solid layout structure and theming, but exhibits alignment inconsistencies and text formatting artifacts in the incident chat timeline.

issues.title: Inconsistent message bubble alignment
issues.description: Chat bubbles lack consistent sender-based horizontal alignment, producing an irregular visual flow.
issues.evidence: Multiple response bubbles show mismatched left and right offsets across the thread.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent left and right alignment classes for incoming and outgoing messages.

issues.title: Unintended word fragmentation
issues.description: Several text strings inside bubbles exhibit broken spacing within words.
issues.evidence: Artifacts appear in words like 'Rever ted', 'Postmorte m', and 'Schedu led'.
issues.suggestion: Remove extraneous spacing in message strings and ensure standard word-break styling.
